input.note: procedural, no generated input: the mesh is built in Blender (scripts/art/studio-kit/build_studio.bpy) and concept.png is a shape reference only, not a TRELLIS input. Earlier note, kept: "Fails the grey-ground rule: both options are a blue wall panel, not a plain grey ground. B kept as the cleaner layout (three equal sheets in a row). The input gate is moot if this is built as a textured plane." The grey-ground rule applies to image-to-3D input, which this asset does not use.

finishing.note: finish: 148 bevelled hard edges, custom (hardened) normals true, 82% of faces smooth-shaded, baked atlas at 1200.5 px/m from 2 CC0 scans; one UV set (1); 6 PBR PNGs (base colour, normal, ORM for 2 slots); every file under 10 MB (largest 1544136 bytes); 2 material slots (pinned_drawings_atlas, draw_sheets); evidence turnaround.jpg and table-view.jpg rendered with Cycles on the CPU (in-context EEVEE renders: scripts/art/studio-kit/render_context.bpy), framing check passes on 5 images (min silhouette margin 0.0641 of the image, rule 0.03). Not claimed: any UE import.

pivot: base centre (x and y at the middle of the footprint, z = 0 at the floor); measured 0, 0 m; the prop stands +Y in the GLB (glTF Y-up), +Z in Blender
scale_reasoning: two framed A3-ish sheets and one pinned, curling sheet, 32 x 48 cm each, 6 cm apart, on a 1.12 x 0.52 m mounting board. Measured 114 x 52 x 3.31 cm (x, up, y); the planned envelope per axis is 100-120 cm, 2-5 cm, 45-55.00000000000001 cm (x, y, z up).
textures: 6 PNGs: one 2048 px atlas (pinned_drawings_atlas_basecolor, _orm with R occlusion, G roughness, B metal, and a tangent-space OpenGL _normal), baked with Cycles on the CPU in scripts/art/studio-kit/build_studio.bpy from layered bake-source materials (scripts/art/lib/finish.bpy): Poly Haven CC0 scans tinted to the palette, curvature edge wear, room-scale grunge, AO (also multiplied into basecolor at 0.55, as the forward-shaded UE scene has no runtime AO). One unique UV set: smart projection, islands at one texel density, hidden faces (book sides inside a row, undersides) shrunk to 0.12, 1200.5 px/m on the visible surface (0.3351 m2 visible, 85% of the surface hidden). Bake seconds: {"base":1.63,"rough":1.48,"metal":0.66,"normal":1.54,"ao":9.33}. draw_sheets_*: a 1536 x 768 procedural 3-up blueprint atlas (each printed face maps one third), a placeholder slot for the drawings the image builder makes. GLB embeds the atlas as quality-92 JPEG (the PNG set would put the GLB over 10 MB).

finish.bevel: angle-limited (30 degrees) bevel on every primitive's hard edges, width per part (0.5 to 3 mm), 2 segments, arc miter, clamped, hardened normals, then a weighted normal (face area, keep sharp) and smooth shading; 148 hard edges bevelled, 644 kept sharp by design (paper edges, spiral roll ends, small screws), 0 convex edges of 60 degrees or more left unrounded (inside other parts or at acute corners)

blender: Blender 5.2.2, scripts/art/studio-kit/build_studio.bpy (build and score), render_studio.bpy (evidence and framing check), write_manifest.mjs
